resources.string: Tap for your suggestion – it adapts to how your day looks.
On days with a workout in your week plan, CruxCoach reminds you at the time you choose. No reminder on rest days, on days you already trained or climbed, or during a pause.
Remind me on planned training days
No week plan yet – without a plan there is nothing to remind you of.
Missed – nothing to make up, the plan simply goes on.
Pause – this day does not count against your week.
Easing back in: week %1$d of %2$d after %3$d days off
Finger re-entry: week %1$d of %2$d after the injury
Shorter sessions (%1$d %%) and no maximal finger load.
Only light finger work, no max hangs – everything else as usual.

After a break, tendons and pulleys need a few sessions to get used to load again, more than muscles do. The ramp ends after one or two weeks, or as soon as you have trained on four days. After a healed finger injury, only the fingers stay off the limit for four weeks. This is not medical advice; if something hurts, stop and get it checked.
